abstract: Lymphovenous shunting in a patient presenting with a metastatic retroperitoneal seminoma is reported. Its aetiology as well as the prognostic value are discussed. A search of the literature has been made and the various theories offered to explain such a phenomonen have been evaluated, in an attempt to corelate them with the findings in our case.
abstract_ja: 転移性後腹膜セミノーマを呈した患者におけるリンパ静脈短絡を報告する。その成因と予後的意義を論じる。文献検索を行い、そのような現象を説明するために提唱された諸説を評価し、本症例の所見と関連付けることを試みた。
